# Price Termite & Pest Control

> > South & Central Florida's trusted pest control and lawn care provider offering same-day service, free inspections, and eco-friendly solutions since 1988.

Price Termite & Pest Control serves residential and commercial customers across South & Central Florida including Palm Beach, Broward, Martin, Indian River, Saint Lucie, and Brevard counties. The company specializes in termite control, pest elimination, lawn care, and arborist services with a commitment to same-day availability and free inspections.

## Core Pest Control Services

- [Residential Pest Control Service](https://www.pricetermite.com/services/pest-control): Same-day residential pest control service covering ants, spiders, cockroaches, and centipedes.
- [Termite Control & Inspection](https://www.pricetermite.com/services/pest-services/termite-control): Termite control service covering drywood and subterranean termite treatment with free inspections.
- [Ant Control & Extermination](https://www.pricetermite.com/pest-control/ant-control): Specialized ant control service including fire ant treatment options.
- [Mosquito & Tick Control](https://www.pricetermite.com/services/pest-services/mosquito-control): Mosquito and tick control service with same-day availability.
- [Rodent Extermination & Exclusion](https://www.pricetermite.com/services/pest-services/rodent-control): Rodent extermination and exclusion service for residential properties.
- [Bed Bug Extermination](https://www.pricetermite.com/services/bed-bug-treatment): Bed bug treatment and extermination service with same-day availability.
- [Commercial Pest Control](https://www.pricetermite.com/services/pest-services/commercial-pest-control): Commercial pest control service for businesses covering flies, moths, cockroaches.

## Lawn Care & Outdoor Services

- [Lawn Pest Control](https://www.pricetermite.com/services/lawn-pest-control): Lawn pest control targeting fire ants, grubs, ticks, and other turf-damaging insects.
- [Lawn Care Services](https://www.pricetermite.com/services/lawn-care): Comprehensive lawn care services including fungicide, fertilization, and grub control.
- [Weed Control & Removal](https://www.pricetermite.com/services/lawn-care/weed-control): Specialized weed removal and control service for Florida lawns.
- [Tree & Shrub Care](https://www.pricetermite.com/services/arborist): Tree and shrub care including arboristry and pest control for trees.

## Specialized Services

- [Pre-Construction Termite Control](https://www.pricetermite.com/termite-control/pre-construction-termite-control): Pre-construction termite inspection and prevention service for contractors.
- [Insulation Installation & Removal](https://www.pricetermite.com/services/insulation-removal-and-installation): TAP insulation installation and removal with rodent prevention benefits.
